row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (no public pricing; free trial)
row.evidence: IBM's Frontdoor docs (the login and user service for all Apptio products including Targetprocess) say Frontdoor "now supports provisioning and deprovisioning of Users directly from an Identity Provider via SCIM Provisioning"; Targetprocess has no public price list.
row.notes: Quote-only: IBM Targetprocess (Apptio) publishes no plans or prices; targetprocess.com/pricing redirects to the Apptio product page, which offers a free trial and Contact Us. SCIM 2.0 arrived on August 11, 2026 through Apptio Frontdoor, which now handles Targetprocess sign-in and users. It supports Users only (create, PUT/PATCH, active=false, DELETE, filter, paging) with OAuth client-credentials auth, documented for Okta and Entra. Group and environment-access management over SCIM is targeted for Q4 2026, so access roles still come from SSO auto-provisioning, the Frontdoor API or manual grants. Deactivating a Frontdoor user deactivates the Targetprocess account within a minute. Legacy Targetprocess SAML with JIT is deprecated in favour of Frontdoor SSO. Okta's 'Targetprocess' OIN app is SWA only; the Entra gallery app is SSO with JIT.

scim.base_url: Domain-specific SCIM Base URL shown on the Frontdoor Domain's SCIM tab

auth.token_source: Frontdoor > Domain Management > View Domain Details > SCIM tab > Create SCIM OAuth Client (client ID and secret; token from https://<frontdoor-url>/api/oauth/token)
auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 client credentials only; two client secrets allowed for rotation.

operations.notes: Deactivation via active=false (Okta 'Deactivate users'); Merge on External ID lets a POST reactivate a deactivated user.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivating the Frontdoor user deactivates the Targetprocess account (within one minute). A SCIM DELETE removes the Frontdoor user and cascades to its environment access and API keys; what happens to the Targetprocess user record after a DELETE is not stated.

pagination.notes: startIndex/count; default page size 100, maximum not stated.

custom.how: Unsupported attributes return 400 per the Okta/Entra notes; unrecognised POST/PUT attributes are ignored.

roles.how: Not over SCIM yet (access and group management targeted for Q4 2026). Targetprocess user type comes from Frontdoor roles, which can be set manually, by API or by SSO auto-provisioning role mapping.

limitations.text: SCIM manages Frontdoor user records only; granting a user access to the Targetprocess environment (roles) is not supported over SCIM until Q4 2026, so SCIM must be combined with SSO auto-provisioning or manual/API access grants.
No Groups resource; IdP group push must be disabled.
Only OAuth 2.0 client-credentials authentication; no static bearer token.
Entra provisions on a 40-minute cycle by default and can overwrite manual changes.

scim.notes: SCIM is provided by Apptio Frontdoor, the shared identity service for all Apptio products including Targetprocess (released August 11, 2026). SCIM creates, updates and deletes Frontdoor users; Targetprocess picks up deactivations and role changes from Frontdoor.

auth.notes: Token generated at /api/v1/Authentication or a personal access token; passed as a query parameter.

capabilities.notes: manage_groups/assign_roles via ProjectMembers (project role assignment); Frontdoor API covers access management.

endpoints.purpose: Update user, e.g. IsActive=false to deactivate (documented as /api/v1/users/23)
Add users to projects with a role

user_api.notes: Targetprocess REST API v1 Users resource (plus the separate Frontdoor API for Frontdoor users and environment access). Targetprocess has no public plans, so the API plan is quote-only like everything else.

okta.notes: OIN 'Targetprocess' app (last updated Jul. 2015) ticks only SWA (read from page markup). Frontdoor's SCIM guide enables SCIM on the Okta app used for the Frontdoor SSO connection.

entra.notes: Entra gallery tutorial covers SAML SSO with JIT for the legacy Targetprocess SSO; Frontdoor's SCIM guide configures provisioning on the enterprise app against the generic SCIM base URL.

fallbacks.notes: Frontdoor SSO auto-provisioning creates users and roles at login but cannot deprovision. CSV: Frontdoor 'Bulk Add users' from a Targetprocess export (How to import Targetprocess Users to Frontdoor).
